## T26 — actual valid inner, immutable outer and healthy controls

Initialize the existing main fixture independently and execute C01/C02; current time1, semantic/publication2, P support1. Prepare the inner C05 explanation Offer **before** finalizing the controlled launch's HookPlan hash. It has its own fresh K/result id and current full witness, human-H/1, internal mode/V=null. It is valid alone with O2/DECLINE. The controlled outer uses the same prior root/witness and a supplied independently validated r1 evidence V. Only the trusted hook at before-write attempts the inner admission.

Caught and uncaught versions must show actual guarded nested entry/rejection, outer poison, and both keys absent. No malformed/stale/unauthorized/unsupported inner may substitute. Protected snapshots/explicit fault/invalid V/caller-owned alias mutation remain separate under R1a; native D01-A/D01-B bytes/assertions are unchanged.

Separate healthy controls have no active fault: outer O1 then second new-key **current-witness** O1 (support3 throughout after first credit; no second revision), and standalone inner O2 then second valid sequential inner O2. Another bound run shows caught outer O4, the same never-committed outer R/V succeeding O1 after fault removal, then a second fresh O1 on the **same Core owner/guard object**. No root reset or replacement Core hides sticky poison. A new immutable invocation/session binding may remove the hook; never edit an active SessionBinding.

## T27 — precise seams and real success before retry

On the same fresh C01/C02 basis, pin nine applicable first-credit Send seams: capture-complete, owner-validation, after-receiving, after-revision, pre-choice-captured, after-reply, final-validation, before-write and post-allocation. Each has one false signal and one B0_SENTINEL exception: **18 separate document bindings**. Their real source entry and signal must be observed; missing or inapplicable source seams are reported with reason/BLOCKED, never counted as passed injections. Unknown-COMMIT interruption windows remain T39, not definite O4 faults.

All nine canonical raw key/payload sets, Witness and last acknowledged state stay equal; staged pure candidates cannot become admitted messages/receivings/revisions/phases or public speech. No compensation event, key reservation or partial acknowledgment. A bound after-receiving failure then removes only that hook: the **same R/K/result id** remains current because no group changed, so it must genuinely succeed O1. Read the actual committed G6 original through authorized AuthorView, compare to R and returned D, then replay exact stored R/V for O3/original D. CommitAnswer has no imaginary R/V fields. Never claim an O3 before this actual successful commit.

Healthy first and second sequential Sends are separately identified. The per-kind applicability matrix preserves non-social clock/checkpoint/root distinctions and direct Delivery initialization: no fictional revision seam on neutral/credited/clock/checkpoint work, no invented Intake, and no assertion of source-bound hook capability before B1 exists.

## T09 — complete performed salience contrast

Each EA salience uses a freshly initialized instance of the reviewed main fixture and exact C01/C02 prefix, fresh operation/result identity and no admitted-world reset. It uses the same authorized asserted current r1, Q/seed-Q-H-1, D blocked=false/opening_only/applicability0..2, terms null/amount0 and H→P actual receiving. Only existing permitted prominence/performance differ; exact full outward words/framing/assertion are pinned.

Compare the **whole actual** pre-choice input before Choice. The unchanged C03 expected object is copied only to set the actual performed outward for each salience; input support3/revision1/credited r1, sources and local introduction context remain exact. No salience selector, expected answer or post-result filter enters Choice. Compare the separately captured raw output after Choice to ACK_SCOPE; then actual presentation and reply receiving/phase/publication. Three authored expected objects are in [V012_EXPECTED_DATA](oracles/V012_EXPECTED_DATA.json), not product output files.

Nearest SE Subtle/Overt compile negatives remain unsupported with valid grammar; T07 actual EA/SE ACK_SCOPE/ACK_CARE, T08 equal-outward Offer parity/DECLINE and T11 raw-input/privacy controls remain unchanged. The 18 P + one Q catalog is unchanged; no full360 or new root/certainty/material capability is added.

## T35 — one wrong commitment, fresh key and correct current storage

Execute exact C01..C07/CP01 prefix in two independently initialized existing-main instances. Current time2, semantic sequence7, storage publication8; **actual** heads are independently rederived, never copied from old planning tokens. Both prepare a supplied-mode R0/V0 for new K/result id `T35-fresh-post-CP01`, never committed C03. The draft value is the **exact old byte-vector C03 Draft**, id C03/revision1, not a renamed literal id. Compile/preview use it freshly against current grants/witness.

Negative changes only `/preview/binding/draft_hash` on an R0 copy. Wrong `SHA256(J(Draft))` is `6affd799bbe5b2214797d59ee7b39bf79224dac85cfde9622aa02886195f163e`; correct Htag(draft,Draft) is `507f100b50dcf86d8952b8f2fcca7b7d99e15354da99e8ca6caf04d10ff50585`. Retain V0 unchanged, no null/discard/reprepare. Required preview validation precedes downstream supplied-result checks: the actual failure must be BAD_PREVIEW at preview, not old-key conflict, stale witness or BAD_RESULT. No key/receipt/receiving/publication/all-nine change.

The matched positive uses otherwise-identical correct R0/V0 on its own same-basis instance and succeeds O1/ACK_SCOPE, support3/no repeat revision, semantic8/publication9. Draft id C03 is only draft metadata; the operation key is fresh. Do not execute the positive first in the negative's installation. Preserve original committed C03 R/V/D and all original exact retries unchanged.

Every accepted Send run explicitly binds the common all-nine positive effect contract: exact G1 semantic records and required G5 edges, one G3/G6/G8 progression and required G9 proof updates; unchanged G2/G4/G7. Exact retry and every technical rejection bind all-nine equality. Future reviewers must derive full raw row expectations from fixed authored types/policies/scoped record identities independently, rather than treating V or summary counts as the oracle.
